tagline: Fuji取景器相机，1979 年发布
description: Fuji于1979年推出的取景器相机。配备Fujinon 40 mm f/8 (3 elements/3 groups) glass lens.。快门速度Mechanical behind-the-lens, 1/125 s.。使用Knob advance, rewind crank.。Fixed focus, close focus mode for flash.。

specs.镜头: Fujinon 40 mm f/8 (3 elements/3 groups) glass lens.
specs.对焦: Fixed focus, close focus mode for flash.
specs.英文简介: Mainly made for export, the Fujica M1 was launched in 1979.
